created_after: stage-0 recording + replay of 20 policies on DEV+REP (all S/F/M/R pilots REJECT or INCONCLUSIVE in replay; oracles: selection {G,L} +0.018, fusion bound +0.020, component bound +0.024, extra candidates {L2,Lp,Lt} +0.033). Frozen before any T-head output and before any causal pilot.

T_heads.variants: T0 (no transfer), T1 (CNN fusion), T2 (+target tokens), T3 (+abstain gate), T4 (+identity gate)
T_heads.data: REP cache every 2nd frame on the live SGGL trajectory; fit/val split 4:1 by video hash
T_heads.positive_control: T1 and T4 on 64 fixed fit items, 1500 steps, lr 1e-3 cosine, bs 8: pass iff fit J - input J >= +0.05
T_heads.main: 3000 steps, bs 8, AdamW 1e-3 cosine, wd 1e-4, grad clip 5, seed 0; same for every variant
T_heads.screen: DEV, output-only along the live SGGL trajectory (all heads in one pass); selection = SGGL's self gate
T_heads.attention_claim: T2/T3/T4 must beat T1 on DEV small units by >= +0.005 (video CI > 0) before any attention-specific benefit is claimed; T1 must beat T0 for any cross-view feature benefit
T_heads.advance: pilot rule on DEV small units (REP is training data): dJF vs SGGL >= +0.005, >= 3 videos up, LOVO min > 0; then a causal rollout

causal_pilots.why: replay keeps SGGL's crop trajectory; verify replay ~ causal for the best point estimate of each non-learned family
causal_pilots.rule: same pilot rule as stage 1 on causal DEV+REP small units
